description: Use this when the user asks about this week, the next week, upcoming days, family schedule for the week, or a multi-day planning overview.

days.description: Number of days to include, from 1 to 14. Defaults to 7.

householdId.description: Optional Familia household id. Omit to use all accessible households.

startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime. Defaults to today.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Prague. Defaults to ASYNQ_TIMEZONE or runtime timezone.

name: familia_get_weekly_overview
title: Weekly overview
